title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 8: Customer Service & Service Level Agreements
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Horizon Enterprise con the Client Services VP.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Horizon Enterprise

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Horizon Enterprise** (Líder a cargo: **the Client Services VP**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Horizon Enterprise's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are answering calls at the service center. B) They are sorting client refund claims. C) The customer care division is closed. D) They are training new support executives.
questions.explanation: Se observa a los agentes de atención al cliente con diademas atendiendo llamadas de soporte en vivo.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi James, did Horizon Enterprise send the new SLA terms?
W: Yes. The Client Services VP wants all client satisfaction rates logged under EliteCRM.
M: Perfect, let's make sure our support team is fully aligned.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
